steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: Get moving! ...

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: What's going on...?

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: (Don't make a sound!)

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: (Nnnh---)

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: (Are they still around?)

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: (They're still here...!)

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: (They seem to searching for something...)

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: (A Reunion member is headed our way! We need to hide!)

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: Must be my imagination.

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: (Can you get a clear shot on him?)

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: (We're too far away...)

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: (The explosions stopped as soon as they appeared...)

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: (They're too spread out. There's no way I'd be able to take out all three at once.)

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: (Also, their movements are nothing like those ordinary street thugs.)

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: (The other Reunion troops don't seem to be dressed as heavily.)

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: (That's right. As you can see, we must be extremely careful. If any of them survive and call for reinforcements, we'll be in serious danger.)

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: (On top of that, I see one person over there in Caster attire, and they seem to be testing something.)

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: (If they're also able to use Detection Arts...)

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: (They might be able to detect us just based upon a bullet we fire.)

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: (So basically, our hands are tied. Even though it's a three versus three, it feels like we've been surrounded.)

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: (Things aren't looking good. I really dislike this kind of feeling.)

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: (Though we're supposed to be the hunters, it feels like all we've been cornered into hiding by bigger prey.)

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: (Wait, they seem to be communicating with someone...)

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: (I can't hear what they're saying from here. I'm going to get closer.)

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: (Don't. It's too risky right now.)

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: (It's too quiet. We don't know what kinds of Infected we're facing yet...)

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: (If any of them have enhanced hearing, we'll be in trouble.)

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: (...What are they waiting for?)

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: (Something feels... off about this.)

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: (Could it be...)

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: (Jessica, are you feeling it too...?)

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: (Y-yeah... I'm also...)

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: (The temperature is dropping again...)

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: (So... cold...)

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: (Could they be behind this...?!)

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: (...! Jessica, why are you biting your fingers--)

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: (So that her teeth don't chatter and make noise.)

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: (I don't think that's necessary yet, but what a diligent kid.)

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: (To me, you're just a kid too.)

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: (As if.)

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: (...It's warming back up again. Those three Reunion members left as well.)

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: Are they testing the functionality of something...?

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: ...They appeared without making a sound, only leaving a trail of shivering cold in their wake.

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: They really are like those 'yetis' from legend.

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: Maybe my guess was right.

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: They might just be yetis.

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: ...Found it.

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: Here's another wall that's been affected by the ice. But, look at this...

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: There's a chunk of black Originium lodged in the corner?

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: No wonder. The cold wave must have emanated from here.

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: There are distinct patterns on the wall.

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: This chunk of Originium is the epicenter of all this.

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: ...When I was a mercenary, there was a rumor circulating around.

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: In the northwest, the Infected were carrying out guerilla warfare against Ursus.

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: Among them was a towering monster.

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: As the rumor went, nothing could hold off its advance.

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: Shields would be crumpled, weapons would be snapped.

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: Everywhere the monster went, only a barren tundra, devoid of life, would remain.

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: And within that guerilla force, there was this one squad...

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: They were like the chill of winter itself.

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: The land was said to freeze underneath their feet.

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: Buildings would collapse, turned into nothing more than grains of snow drifting across an empty battlefield.

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: The trenches where the Ursus soldiers were stationed became their icy grave.

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: Are you saying that...

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: Yes. I think this is that very legend...

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: ...the 'Yeti Squadron.'

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: Let's keep going. I have a feeling that we're going to find the Reunion base soon.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Ugh...

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: What's wrong?

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Do you smell that as well...

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: ...the smell of something burning?
